headline: Mongolia's president announces resignation amid corruption allegations
summary: Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh announced he will step down amid allegations linked to a possible $110 million bribe in a state railway project. He called the charges slander and said he will cooperate with the investigation.
why: Mongolia's economy depends heavily on mining exports, and its state infrastructure projects shape investor confidence in the country's governance and foreign financing.
original_headline: Mo‘g‘uliston prezidenti korrupsiya ayblovlari fonida iste’foga chiqishini e’lon qildi
